binniecore.ponder.genetics_pipeline.head: Genetics Machine Workflow
binniecore.ponder.splicer.header: Applying Gene Arrays with the Splicer
binniecore.ponder.alveary_components.tex: Binnie's Alveary blocks replace normal blocks in the outside walls of a Forestry Alveary. The Alveary still uses the same 3×3×3 body and slab roof.
The Mutator consumes mutagen items to increase the chance of bee mutations. The bonus has a limit, so adding more does not increase it forever.
The Frame Housing holds one Forestry frame and applies that frame's effects to the Alveary. The frame loses durability while the Alveary runs.
The Rain Shield lets bees that normally stop in the rain keep working through bad weather.
The Lighting block provides artificial light so bees that need daylight can keep working when the light is too low.
The Stimulator takes a compatible circuit board and applies its bee modifiers while it has power.
The Hatchery can produce larvae while a healthy queen is working and stores the larvae inside.
The Transmission block takes FE and shares it with Alveary components that need power.
binniecore.ponder.botany_breeding.text_1: Binnie's flowers have genes just like bees and trees. Two flowers can look the same but still carry different active and inactive genes, so the parents you use matter.
binniecore.ponder.botany_breeding.text_2: Pollen carries the genes of the flower it came from. Use it on another mature flower to pollinate that flower.
binniecore.ponder.botany_breeding.text_3: Pollinated flowers can produce Seeds with genes from both parents. Grow the Seeds and keep the offspring with the traits you want.
binniecore.ponder.botany_breeding.text_4: Flower soil tracks moisture, acidity, fertility and weedkiller. Use the Soil Meter to check it, then water or fertilise the soil as needed.
binniecore.ponder.laboratory_machine.tex: The Lab Stand holds Binnie's genetics Databases and displays the mounted Database on top.
Right-click the Lab Stand with a compatible Database to place it on the stand.
Right-click a Lab Stand with a Database on it to open that Database without carrying it around.
binniecore.ponder.genetics_pipeline.text: The main Genetics workflow starts with an organism. First, isolate one of its genes, sequence it, put that gene into a Serum, charge the Serum, then apply it to another organism.
The Isolator uses an Empty Sequencer to take one gene from the organism. The result is an unsequenced Sequence. The Sequencer reads that Sequence with Fluorescent Dye and returns the Empty Sequencer.
Once a gene has been discovered, it can be put into a Serum or Serum Array. The Polymeriser charges it with Polymerising Bacteria and Raw DNA so it can be used in the next machines.
The Inoculator uses Vector Bacteria to apply a charged Serum to an organism. Flowers are modified as Pollen, not as grown Flowers.

The other machines handle the rest of the lab work. The Analyser reveals genetic information, the Gene Pool makes Raw DNA, the Incubator makes lab fluids, and the Acclimatiser changes climate tolerances.
binniecore.ponder.isolator.text_1: Put an organism, an Empty Sequencer and Enzyme into the Isolator, then supply Bioethanol. It takes one active or inactive gene and produces an unsequenced Sequence.
binniecore.ponder.isolator.text_2: The organism can be lost while the gene is being extracted. If it is valuable breeding stock, keep a spare before putting it into the Isolator.
binniecore.ponder.sequencer.text_1: The Sequencer reads the unsequenced Sequence made by the Isolator. Add Fluorescent Dye and it works through the sample until the gene has been identified.
binniecore.ponder.sequencer.text_2: When it finishes, the discovered gene is recorded for you and the Empty Sequencer is returned. A Database can then be used to view the genes you have discovered.
binniecore.ponder.polymeriser.text_1: The Polymeriser adds charges to a Serum or Serum Array. Supply Polymerising Bacteria and Raw DNA, then put the Serum into the machine. A charged Gold Nugget can be added to speed it up.
binniecore.ponder.polymeriser.text_2: Each run adds one charge to the Serum. A Serum can hold up to sixteen charges, and using it in another machine spends a charge.
binniecore.ponder.inoculator.text_1: The Inoculator applies the genes stored in a charged Serum to an organism. Flowers have to be modified as Pollen, not as grown Flowers.
binniecore.ponder.inoculator.text_2: Supply Vector Bacteria, the organism and the Serum. When it finishes, the organism comes back with the new gene and the Serum loses one charge.
binniecore.ponder.splicer.text_1: The Splicer applies a charged Serum Array to an organism. Like the Inoculator, flowers have to be used as Pollen.
binniecore.ponder.splicer.text_2: It does not need Vector Bacteria and works much faster than the Inoculator, but it uses a lot more FE.
binniecore.ponder.analyser.text_1: The Analyser reveals genetic information that has not been analysed yet. Put in an organism or an unanalysed Sequence together with DNA Dye.
binniecore.ponder.analyser.text_2: The same item comes back analysed. Its genetic information can then be read instead of being hidden.
binniecore.ponder.genepool.text_1: The Gene Pool breaks down an organism to make Raw DNA. It needs Enzyme and Bioethanol to process the organism.
binniecore.ponder.genepool.text_2: The organism is consumed. Raw DNA collects in the output tank and is mainly used to charge Serums in the Polymeriser.
binniecore.ponder.incubator.text_1: The Incubator makes several fluids used by the Genetics machines. Give it the right fluid and reagent, and it will keep processing while both are available.
binniecore.ponder.incubator.text_3: A Growth Medium item and Water make Growth Medium fluid.
binniecore.ponder.incubator.text_4: Wheat and Growth Medium fluid produce Bacteria.
binniecore.ponder.incubator.text_5: White Dye turns Bacteria into Polymerising Bacteria. Blaze Powder turns Bacteria into Vector Bacteria. Both fluids are used later when charging or applying genes.
binniecore.ponder.acclimatiser.text_1: The Acclimatiser changes an organism's pH, temperature and humidity tolerances. Put the organism in with a reagent for the tolerance you want to change.
binniecore.ponder.acclimatiser.text_2: Powdered Mulch pushes pH tolerance toward acidic conditions. Powdered Ash pushes it toward alkaline conditions.
binniecore.ponder.acclimatiser.text_3: Lava and Snow change temperature tolerance, while Water and Sand change humidity tolerance in opposite directions.
binniecore.ponder.acclimatiser.text_4: The organism itself is the output. Its tolerance genes are changed instead of creating a separate item.
